\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 259-260 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:ML-R263-first-pass-words-from-chapters-259-260}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a bakery and a supermarket.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a bitter gourd, okra, a drumstick, maize, chickpeas
  \item business, a shopkeeper, a weighing scale, a kilo, a thing
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A bitter gourd? (\textbf{\ml{പാവയ്ക്ക}}, \emph{pāvaykka}.) Okra? (\textbf{\ml{വെണ്ടയ്ക്ക}}, \emph{veṇṭaykka}.) A drumstick? (\textbf{\ml{മുരിങ്ങക്ക}}, \emph{muriṅṅakka}.) Maize? (\textbf{\ml{ചോളം}}, \emph{cōḷaṁ}.) Chickpeas? (\textbf{\ml{കടല}}, \emph{kaṭala}.) Business? (\textbf{\ml{കച്ചവടം}}, \emph{kaccavaṭaṁ}.) A shopkeeper? (\textbf{\ml{കച്ചവടക്കാരൻ}}, \emph{kaccavaṭakkāran}.) A weighing scale? (\textbf{\ml{തുലാസ്}}, \emph{tulāsŭ}.) A kilo? (\textbf{\ml{കിലോ}}, \emph{kilō}.) A thing? (\textbf{\ml{സാധനം}}, \emph{sādhanaṁ}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 261-263 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:ML-R263-second-pass-words-from-chapters-261-263}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a postman and an interview.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a postman, an interview, a vacancy, training, a report
  \item a note, an example, an artist, a temple priest, a singer
  \item a carpenter, a mason, a watchman, a bakery, a supermarket
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A postman? (\textbf{\ml{പോസ്റ്റ്മാൻ}}, \emph{pōsṟṟmān}.) An interview? (\textbf{\ml{അഭിമുഖം}}, \emph{abhimukhaṁ}.) A vacancy? (\textbf{\ml{ഒഴിവ്}}, \emph{oḻivŭ}.) Training? (\textbf{\ml{പരിശീലനം}}, \emph{pariśīlanaṁ}.) A report? (\textbf{\ml{റിപ്പോർട്ട്}}, \emph{ṟippōrṭṭŭ}.) A note? (\textbf{\ml{കുറിപ്പ്}}, \emph{kuṟippŭ}.) An example? (\textbf{\ml{ഉദാഹരണം}}, \emph{udāharaṇaṁ}.) An artist? (\textbf{\ml{കലാകാരൻ}}, \emph{kalākāran}.) A temple priest? (\textbf{\ml{പൂജാരി}}, \emph{pūjāri}.) A singer? (\textbf{\ml{ഗായകൻ}}, \emph{gāyakan}.) A carpenter? (\textbf{\ml{ആശാരി}}, \emph{āśāri}.) A mason? (\textbf{\ml{മേസ്തിരി}}, \emph{mēstiri}.) A watchman? (\textbf{\ml{കാവൽക്കാരൻ}}, \emph{kāvalkkāran}.) A bakery? (\textbf{\ml{ബേക്കറി}}, \emph{bēkkaṟi}.) A supermarket? (\textbf{\ml{സൂപ്പർമാർക്കറ്റ്}}, \emph{sūpparmārkkaṟṟŭ}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
